title: Tasuki SLOs
description: Every SLO's SLI, error budget and burn rates, from the Sloth recording rules (design §9).

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: tasuki-prod or tasuki-dev. Both share one cluster and one Prometheus; only prod has SLOs.

panels.title: Error budget remaining (28 days)
panels.description: Share of each SLO's 28-day error budget left. Orange at 25 % or less (reliability work first), red at 0 (feature freeze; the rollout gate blocks canaries). See the error-budget policy.

panels.title: Error budget remaining over time
panels.description: How each budget is being spent. A steady slope is normal background errors; a cliff is an incident. Dashed lines: 25 % (SLOErrorBudgetLow) and 0 (SLOErrorBudgetExhausted). The rollout gate reads this same series before every canary step.

panels.title: Burn rate now (last hour)
panels.description: Each SLO's error ratio over the last hour divided by its budget. Below 1× the budget lasts the whole 28 days. Orange from 1×; red from 5.6×, the slower page threshold.

panels.title: SLI, last hour
panels.description: Share of POST /v1/quotes and POST /v1/orders requests that do not return 5xx, over the last hour. Green at or above the 99.9 % objective.

panels.title: SLI, 28 days
panels.description: Share of POST /v1/quotes and POST /v1/orders requests that do not return 5xx, over the 28-day SLO window. Sloth averages the 5-minute ratios, so a bad quiet hour weighs as much as a bad busy hour.

panels.title: Error budget remaining
panels.description: Share of the 28-day error budget (0.1% of events may be bad) still unspent. 25 % or less opens SLOErrorBudgetLow; 0 or less opens SLOErrorBudgetExhausted, freezes features and makes the rollout gate block this service's canaries.

panels.title: Page burn rate (5m & 1h > 13.44×, 30m & 6h > 5.6×)
panels.description: Burn rate per alert window: error ratio ÷ budget. The page alert fires when 5m and 1h are both above 13.44× (2 % of the budget in an hour; all of it in about 2 days), or 30m and 6h are both above 5.6× (5 % in 6 hours). The long window proves the burn is real; the short one makes the alert stop soon after the fix.

panels.title: Ticket burn rate (2h & 1d > 2.8×, 6h & 3d > 0.93×)
panels.description: The slow-burn windows. The ticket alert fires when 2h and 1d are both above 2.8× (10 % of the budget in a day), or 6h and 3d are both above 0.93× (on course to spend the whole budget in about 30 days). Fix within working hours.

panels.title: SLI, last hour
panels.description: Share of POST /v1/orders requests served in under 300 ms, over the last hour. Green at or above the 95 % objective.

panels.title: SLI, 28 days
panels.description: Share of POST /v1/orders requests served in under 300 ms, over the 28-day SLO window. Sloth averages the 5-minute ratios, so a bad quiet hour weighs as much as a bad busy hour.

panels.title: Rollout gate decisions / hour
panels.description: Decisions the rollout gate gave Argo Rollouts canary analyses, by outcome and cause. budget: the error budget decided. no_data / prometheus_error: the gate could not read a budget and failed closed (canary blocked); RolloutGateBudgetUnknown opens a ticket.
